"Create a top-down isometric action-roguelike game titled \"RuneBlight: Altars of the Abyss\".

1. THEME @COMMENT_BODY@ ART STYLE:
- Theme: Dark Gothic Fantasy @COMMENT_BODY@ Lovecraftian horror.
- Visuals: Dark, gloomy, ash-grey environments with vibrant neon-glowing magic (purple, blood red, necrotic green) creating high-contrast lighting.
- Audio/Atmosphere: Ominous, heavy, fast-paced combat sound effects.

2. CORE GAMEPLAY @COMMENT_BODY@ MOVEMENT:
- Viewpoint: Top-down / Isometric perspective.
- Controls: Fast directional movement, melee/ranged attack system, and a Dash with invulnerability frames (iframes).
- Rune Momentum System: Continuous attacks without taking damage temporarily boost attack speed and area of effect. Taking damage resets the combo.

3. CORE UNIQUE MECHANIC (CARNAL SCULPTING):
- Players do not pick up weapons from chests. They carve runes into 3 body slots: Arms, Legs, Torso.
- High Risk / High Reward: Equipping a powerful rune grants a devastating ability but permanently lowers base stats for the current run (e.g., reduces max HP, decreases vision range, or costs HP per attack).

4. SYNERGY SYSTEM EXAMPLE:
- Weapon Ability (Arms): Blood Scythe — Heavy damage, but costs 5 HP per attack.
- Movement Ability (Legs): Parasite Step — Dash steals 10 HP per enemy passed through.
- Torso Ability: Shadow Echo — Leaving a shadow clone on Dash that repeats the last attack without paying the HP cost.

5. LEVEL DESIGN @COMMENT_BODY@ BIOMES:
- Procedurally generated rooms connected in a branching map (Slay the Spire style vitral/glass-shattering map system).
- Biome 1 (Submerged Cathedrals): Dark waters, smoke traps that block light, damage taken when staying in complete darkness.
- Biome 2 (Pit of Wax @COMMENT_BODY@ Bones): Sticky wax pools that slow down movement by 50% unless the player dashes.
- Biome 3 (The Stone Womb): Flesh-stone core with vein hazards erupting pulsing toxic blood.

6. ROGUELITE LOOP @COMMENT_BODY@ META-PROGRESSION:
- Permadeath: Dying resets all equipped runes, temporary run currency (Soul Ashes), and current stats.
- Permanent Currency (Petrified Blood): Kept after death.
- Hub Area (Shattered Sanctuary): A dark ruined church suspended above the pit where players spend Petrified Blood to unlock permanent upgrades (higher base HP, extra rune slots, new base weapons).

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable top-down isometric action roguelike titled “RuneBlight: Altars of the Abyss” that matches the requested dark gothic Lovecraftian theme, rune-crafting mechanics, procedural room flow, and roguelite progression.

## Requirements
- Dark Gothic Fantasy / Lovecraftian horror visual theme with ash-grey environments and neon-glow accents.
- Top-down isometric action combat with movement, melee/ranged attacks, and a dash with invulnerability frames.
- Rune Momentum system: continuous attack without taking damage temporarily boosts attack speed and area of effect; taking damage resets momentum.
- Carnal sculpting rune system across Arms, Legs, and Torso with high-risk/high-reward tradeoffs.
- Branching room progression and biome variety: Submerged Cathedrals, Pit of Wax & Bones, Stone Womb.
- Roguelite loop with permanent Petrified Blood progression and temporary Soul Ash reset on death.
- Main menu, sanctuary hub, rune selection, combat loop, altar interactions, and responsive controls.
- “Briefly note assumptions when finished” and save screenshots for validation only if needed.

## Decisions
- Built as a self-contained browser game in `index.html` using HTML5 Canvas for a fast playable prototype without additional dependencies.
- Chose a single-page game loop with procedural enemy spawning, altar progression, and Sanctuary upgrade panels to satisfy the request in a compact implementation.
- Implemented a simplified but functional rune system and room flow rather than a full production-scale roguelike: each rune slot is represented, combat and progression are playable, and the world is rendered in a dark isometric style.
- Kept progression persistent via `localStorage` for Petrified Blood.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created the initial playable game structure and title screen.
- Added core gameplay systems: movement, attack, dash, enemy AI, wall/room bounds, particles, combat feedback, and UI/HUD.
- Added RuneBlight theme, biome/hazard visuals, altar interaction, rune selection, and Shattered Sanctuary upgrade screen.
- Added death/reset loop with Petrified Blood persistence and Soul Ash reset.
- Started a local web server on port 3002 for browser testing.

### Active
- Browser smoke test of the game page and gameplay behavior.

### Blocked
- None explicitly; validation is in progress but not yet confirmed with a browser screenshot.

## Next Move
1. Open the game in a browser at `http://localhost:3002` and verify the page loads and the menu/gameplay functions.
2. Check for JS/runtime issues, input problems, and any broken progression flow.
3. Fix any issues found, then re-test the game loop and main mechanics.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: main game implementation, all game logic, visuals, UI, and controls.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/start.sh`: project start script.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/capture.sh`: screenshot/capture script.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/README.md`: project overview.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/.gitignore`: repo ignore list.

## Important Context
- The implemented prototype is a single-file canvas game, not a full engine project.
- A local HTTP server was started on port 3002 during validation setup.
- `localStorage` is used to persist Petrified Blood between deaths; this is the current permanent currency mechanism.
- The game is currently uncommitted in the working tree as new files.

## Objective

## Requirements
- Gothic/Lovecraftian theme, isometric combat, rune and momentum systems, branching rooms, three biomes, and persistent roguelite progression.
- Briefly note assumptions when finished; save screenshots only if needed.

## Decisions
- Implemented as a self-contained HTML5 Canvas game in `index.html`, with no additional dependencies.
- Petrified Blood persists through `localStorage`; Soul Ash resets on death.

- Implemented title screen, combat loop, rune choices, altar progression, sanctuary, and death/reset flow.
- Fixed player rune-slot initialization and reset run-specific rune slots when starting a run.

- `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` fails because its expected Chromium executable is missing (`Browser "chromium" is not installed`); system Chromium exists at `/usr/bin/chromium`, but it has not yet been configured for Playwright.

## Next Move
1. Configure Playwright to use `/usr/bin/chromium` or use another available browser route; smoke test title, combat, altar, map, mobile controls, and sanctuary.

- Chromium screenshot generation previously succeeded before the latest fixes, but the latest browser test has not succeeded.
